description: Fix Problem 2 (multi-provider support: Gemini / Groq / OpenAI-ChatGPT). Add a provider picker (SELECT dropdown) to the Settings API Key section AND the onboarding apikey slide so the user chooses which provider's key they are entering. Route the CHAT pipeline to the selected provider while reusing MAYRA_SYSTEM_PROMPT as the system message and preserving chat history/context across all three providers. Keep Gemini function-calling; Groq/OpenAI are text-only (documented limitation). Voice stays Gemini-only: if the selected provider is Groq/OpenAI, gracefully tell the user in Mayra's warm voice that voice needs a Gemini key, without breaking the existing Gemini voice path. Relabel the 'Gemini API Key' UI to a multi-provider 'AI API Key' with the provider picker, in warm Hinglish. Depends on FEAT-001 (storage provider + three-state validator).
steps: Chat routing: extend the chat pipeline to support three providers. Preferred approach: add Groq + OpenAI branches to js/gemini-chat.js (rename conceptually to a provider router but KEEP the module + GeminiChat.send(userText, apiKey, systemInstruction) signature so app.js callers and voice are unaffected), OR create a new js/chat-router.js that GeminiChat delegates to. If you create a NEW top-level .js file, you MUST: add it to scripts/copy-web.js is not needed (js/ dir is already copied wholesale), BUT add a <script src> tag in index.html before app.js AND add it to sw.js APP_SHELL list. Simplest path that respects existing wiring: keep everything inside js/gemini-chat.js and branch on Storage.getProvider().

In the chat send path: read provider via Storage.getProvider(). For 'gemini': keep the EXISTING generateContent flow (model gemini-2.0-flash) INCLUDING function-calling via MayraFunctions.TOOL_DECLARATIONS and the existing follow-up turn logic — do not regress it. For 'groq': POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions with header Authorization: Bearer <key>, model 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', body { model, messages:[{role:'system',content:MAYRA_SYSTEM_PROMPT}, ...history mapped to {role:'user'|'assistant',content}, {role:'user',content:userText}], temperature ~0.85 }. For 'openai': POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, Authorization: Bearer <key>, model 'gpt-4o-mini', same OpenAI-style messages shape. Both return {ok:true,text} (text-only; no function execution). Map history from Storage.getChatHistory() (roles are 'user'/'model'; convert 'model' -> 'assistant' for OpenAI-format providers).

Preserve context + persistence for ALL providers: after a successful Groq/OpenAI reply, persist the turn via Storage.appendMessage('user', userText) and Storage.appendMessage('model', replyText), exactly like the Gemini text path, so history/context carries across providers and the chat counter/stats keep working.

Error handling for Groq/OpenAI mirrors Gemini: 401/403 -> warm 'API key sahi nahi laga' style {ok:false, error:'invalid_key', message}; 429 -> warm busy message; network/throw -> warm 'Network mein dikkat' message. Never surface raw provider error JSON to the user.

System prompt: MAYRA_SYSTEM_PROMPT (defined in app.js) must be used as the system message for every provider. It is passed into GeminiChat.send as systemInstruction already; reuse that same value for the Groq/OpenAI system message. Do not fork Mayra's personality per provider.

Provider-aware validation (extend FEAT-001 _testApiKey): add branches for groq (GET or minimal POST to a Groq endpoint with Authorization: Bearer <key>; 401/403 -> auth_error, ok/other-reachable -> valid, throw -> network_error) and openai (GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models with Authorization: Bearer <key>; 401/403 -> auth_error, ok -> valid, throw -> network_error). Same three-state contract; never reject on network failure.

Voice gating in js/app.js _startVoice(): if Storage.getProvider() !== 'gemini' (or the selected provider has no gemini key), do NOT open the WebSocket. Instead show a warm Mayra-voice toast like 'Awaaz wali baat abhi sirf Gemini key se hoti hai — Gemini chuno toh main bol paungi ❤️' and keep text chat fully working. Do NOT alter the Gemini voice pipeline itself. (Optional nicety: if a gemini key is separately stored, you may still allow voice; keep it simple and safe.)

UI — Settings (index.html #screen-settings API Key section): change the heading text/icon copy from 'Gemini API Key' to a multi-provider label (e.g. 'AI API Key'). Add a <select id="settings-provider"> with options Gemini / Groq / OpenAI (ChatGPT) and an onchange that calls a new App method (e.g. App.onProviderChange('settings')). Keep input id 'settings-api-key' and status id 'settings-api-status' unchanged. Update the placeholder/hint copy to reflect the chosen provider in warm Hinglish.

UI — Onboarding apikey slide (index.html data-slide="apikey"): add a matching <select id="onboard-provider"> with the same three options and onchange App.onProviderChange('onboard'); keep input id 'onboard-api-key' and error id 'onboard-api-error'. Update the slide copy to mention Gemini/Groq/ChatGPT choice warmly.

In js/app.js: add onProviderChange(context) that reads the matching provider <select>, calls Storage.setProvider(value), refreshes placeholder/hint copy, and (in settings) refreshes the key status line to reflect whether that provider already has a saved key. Add onProviderChange to the App public export. In _prefillSettings(), set the #settings-provider value from Storage.getProvider() and update the placeholder accordingly. validateAndSaveApiKey must read the currently selected provider (from the context-appropriate select) and validate+save under that provider.
sw.js: add 'api.groq.com' and 'api.openai.com' to the same never-cache/bypass rule that currently exempts generativelanguage.googleapis.com, so LLM calls always hit the network.

Document the limitation in a code comment where Groq/OpenAI branches live: function-calling (device actions like openApp/callContact) is Gemini-only; Groq/OpenAI return text-only replies. Voice is Gemini-only.

Verify: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check` on every changed .js file; confirm any new App method (onProviderChange, plus any others) referenced in index.html onclick/onchange is present in App's returned export; confirm sw.js bypass includes the two new hosts; confirm the Gemini function-calling path in gemini-chat.js is intact.
acceptance_criteria: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check` passes for all changed JS files (js/gemini-chat.js, js/app.js, and any new js file).
Settings and onboarding each show a provider <select> (ids settings-provider / onboard-provider) with Gemini, Groq, OpenAI/ChatGPT options; existing input/status/error ids are unchanged.

Chat send routes by Storage.getProvider(): Gemini keeps generateContent + function-calling; Groq POSTs api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions with Bearer auth and model llama-3.3-70b-versatile; OpenAI POSTs api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with Bearer auth and model gpt-4o-mini.
MAYRA_SYSTEM_PROMPT is the system message for all three providers and chat history/context is persisted (Storage.appendMessage) and reused across providers.
Selecting Groq/OpenAI and starting voice shows a warm Mayra-voice message that voice needs Gemini, and does NOT open the Gemini Live WebSocket; the Gemini voice pipeline code is otherwise unchanged.
_testApiKey has gemini/groq/openai branches all returning the three-state result; network failure never yields a rejection.
sw.js never-cache bypass includes api.groq.com and api.openai.com.
Every App method referenced from index.html (including onProviderChange) is present in App's public export; if a new .js file was added it is in index.html <script> tags and sw.js APP_SHELL.
verification: grep for onProviderChange (and any new App methods) in index.html and confirm each exists in the App return object in js/app.js
grep for 'api.groq.com' and 'api.openai.com' in sw.js and confirm both are in the bypass/never-cache branch
Re-read the gemini branch of the chat router to confirm function_declarations / function-call handling is unchanged
node scripts/copy-web.js and confirm no missing-file warnings for any newly referenced asset
findings: Completed multi-provider support. JS routing (js/app.js onProviderChange + _testApiKey three-state gemini/groq/openai branches + voice gating on Storage.getProvider()!=='gemini'; js/gemini-chat.js provider branch delegating groq/openai to _sendOpenAICompatible while keeping the Gemini generateContent + function-calling path intact) was already present in the working tree from the prior interrupted session and left unchanged after verification. Remaining UI/config work done this turn: (1) index.html onboarding apikey slide (data-slide='apikey') got a <select id='onboard-provider'> with Gemini/Groq/OpenAI options, onchange=App.onProviderChange('onboard'), and warmer copy mentioning the three providers; input id 'onboard-api-key' and error id 'onboard-api-error' unchanged. (2) index.html Settings API Key section relabeled from 'Gemini API Key' to 'AI API Key' with a warm Hinglish hint and a <select id='settings-provider'> (same three options, onchange=App.onProviderChange('settings')); input id 'settings-api-key' and status id 'settings-api-status' unchanged; bottom privacy hint reworded to mention the chosen provider instead of only Google. (3) sw.js never-cache/bypass branch now includes api.groq.com and api.openai.com alongside generativelanguage.googleapis.com (header comment updated too). (4) css/styles.css added a .provider-select style using existing design tokens (matches .api-key-input-wrap input). (5) Code comments documenting the limitation (function-calling/device actions Gemini-only, Groq/OpenAI text-only, voice Gemini-only) already present at the top of js/gemini-chat.js and above _sendOpenAICompatible. _prefillSettings() already sets #settings-provider from Storage.getProvider() and refreshes placeholder/status; onProviderChange refreshes placeholder/hint and (settings) the key status line; validateAndSaveApiKey reads Storage.getProvider() (kept in sync by onProviderChange) before validating/saving; the Groq/OpenAI branch uses MAYRA_SYSTEM_PROMPT as the system message, maps history 'model'->'assistant', and persists both user+model turns via Storage.appendMessage. VERIFICATION (static, INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, NODE_OPTIONS unset): `node --check js/app.js js/gemini-chat.js sw.js` all pass; grep confirms onProviderChange + all other App.* referenced in index.html (onboardNext, validateAndSaveApiKey, skipApiKey, toggleApiKeyVisibility) are in the App public export; grep confirms both new hosts in the sw.js bypass branch; re-read confirms the Gemini function_declarations / _processResponse / _buildHistoryWithFunctionResults path is unchanged; `node scripts/copy-web.js` copies all assets with no missing-file warnings. Not committed/pushed per orchestrator instructions.
